connector.name: ActionsPulse
connector.registryDescription: Real-time GitHub Actions observability: DORA Metrics, Cost Analysis, CI/CD Health dashboards.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image actions-pulse:v2.3.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tsviz account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: GitHub Personal Access Token (fine-grained recommended) with read access to Actions, Administration, Deployments, Issues, Pull Requests

env.name: GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_SLUG
env.description: Enterprise slug for enhanced cross-org features (optional)

env.name: DEFAULT_REPO_FILTER
env.description: Comma-separated list of repository names to monitor (e.g., 'my-app,my-api,frontend'). If not set, all org repos are queried.
